Question 3
?

Consider the augmented matrix M given by M=[1037012−30000] Find the general solution of the linear system represented by the matrix.

a
[−7+3z−3+2zz],z∈(−∞,∞)
b
[−3−3z7−2zz],z∈(−∞,∞)
c
[7+3z3−2zz],z∈(−∞,∞)
d
No solution
e
[7−3z−3−2zz],z∈(−∞,∞)
